periods.time: Two days after the Seven Stars award ceremony

name.zh: 一等星庆功宴与各自的暑假目标
name.en: Ittousei Victory Party and Future Paths

periods.location: Moroboshi family okonomiyaki restaurant Ittousei, Osaka
periods.summary: Ikki's friends and rivals gather at Moroboshi's restaurant to celebrate his Seven Stars victory. The party becomes a transition point: Moroboshi chooses the Toushin League, Toka aims for the National and A-League route, Kanata forces Rinna to abandon future Rebellion help, Shizuku resolves to study healing under Kiriko, and Nagi prepares to visit a friend's grave.
periods.cause: Moroboshi invites Ikki and his acquaintances to celebrate after Ikki wins the Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival.
periods.process: Kagami leads a toast and shows tournament photos; Stella and Shizuku react to the dangerous final; Moroboshi and Toka discuss future pro paths; Kanata exploits Rinna's manga obsession to stop her underground involvement; Shizuku explains to Nagi why she wants Kiriko as a teacher; the party ends with a plan to visit a bathhouse.
periods.outcome: The Seven Stars cast separates for summer, each heading toward new training, careers, or personal goals while Ikki and Stella prepare for Vermillion.
periods.significance: Serves as the post-tournament epilogue and sets several character trajectories for the next arc.
